scope_label: Specification chain: programming, mandate and drafting of common conformity specifications
pattern_rule: Programming-mandate-drafting chain: a programming duty (lists and timetable, conditional on consultation of an advisory forum and based on the essential requirements) -> a request to an external drafting body to produce specifications in the form of NETs -> a consultation duty of the drafting body; the essential requirements on which priority-setting is based are themselves supplemented by the Council on a Commission proposal
governance_question: Who sets priorities for, mandates and shapes the common conformity specifications, and on what stated basis?
organizing_mechanism: Commission programming duty (A4.P0.pt1) conditioned on consultation of the Committee and based on essential requirements (A4.P0.pt1.dash2) whose list the Council supplements on a Commission proposal (A3.P0, A2.P0.pt17); Commission request to the CEPT (A4.P0.pt2); CEPT consultation duty (A4.P0.pt2)
warrant_basis: Warranted by the explicit textual linkage between the essential-requirements basis of the priority list (A4.P0.pt1.dash2) and the Council competence over that list (A3.P0), and between the lists and the request for specifications (A4.P0.pt2); not by shared chapter or vocabulary

scope_label: Recognition of certificates of conformity for type approval
pattern_rule: Issuer-recognizer pattern: a certificate issued on tests by an approved laboratory (accompanied by data) must be recognized by the competent authorities of the Member States, which may not re-test and must use the common conformity specifications; recognition is conditional on a specification whose references are published
governance_question: Whose test results and certificates must competent authorities accept in type approval, under what conditions, and what may they not do?
organizing_mechanism: Recognition obligation (A6.P2) conditioned on a certificate of conformity with the relevant common conformity specification whose references are published; certificate accompanied by data (A7.P3); prohibition of further tests (A6.P2); mandatory use of specifications (A6.P3); implementation duty (A1.P0)
warrant_basis: Warranted by the single qualified coupling issuer-certificate-recognizer stated across A6.P2, A7.P3 and A2.P0.pt16 (explicit cross-references), not by theme

scope_label: Qualification, notification and publication of authorities and laboratories
pattern_rule: Qualification-notification chain: laboratory verification and approval by Member State or recognized body (definition-derived) -> notification of competent authorities and approved laboratories and regular reports to the Commission -> publication of the authorities list by the Commission and consultation of the Committee on laboratory approval problems and on fair competition among laboratories
governance_question: How are approved laboratories and competent authorities qualified, made known to the Commission and followed up?
organizing_mechanism: Verification and approval of laboratories (A2.P0.pt8) -> notification and reports (A7.P1, A7.P2) -> publication of the authorities list (A7.P1) and Committee consultations (A5.P2.ptb, A7.P5)
warrant_basis: Warranted by the sequence of qualified relations around the same objects (authorities and approved laboratories) from approval to notification to follow-up; the transmission of lists and reports to the Committee (A7.P2) is NOT used because its transmitter is unspecified (HQ-DIRECTION)

scope_label: Waiver (derogation) from the use of common conformity specifications in purchasing
pattern_rule: Conditional-dependency chain: Member State duty to ensure use of specifications in purchasing, with exceptions -> waiver (b) on market consultation and unavoidable need -> notification and statement of departures -> urgent Commission consultation of the Committee and possible request to the CEPT to revise -> periodic Committee review -> cessation on evidence from another Member State (if no revision request) or extension with Commission agreement on Committee advice
governance_question: When may purchasing depart from the common conformity specifications, and how are such waivers notified, reviewed, ended or extended?
organizing_mechanism: Explicit triggers and conditions in A7.P4.ptb, A7.P4.sub2 and A7.P4.sub3 ("In this case", "In the event that a request for revision is not made", "provided that the Commission, on the advice of the Committee, agrees")
warrant_basis: Warranted by the explicit conditional and procedural dependencies among the steps of A7.P4; not by shared chapter or vocabulary

scope_label: Suspension of recognition, revocation and the associated Community procedure
pattern_rule: Safeguard-procedure pattern: unilateral Member State competence to suspend recognition on stated grounds (a) or (b) -> notification with reasons -> ground (a): consultation, opinion of a laboratory, communication, comments, recommendations, funding/reimbursement; ground (b): referral to the Committee, urgent opinion, Commission decision on withdrawal from the published list, information and further brief to the CEPT; revocation of approved type approval triggers the paragraph 1 and 2 procedures
governance_question: How is a Member State's suspension or revocation reviewed at Community level, and with what consequences?
organizing_mechanism: Chain of triggered duties in A8.P1 to A8.P5 with explicit conditions ("If it exercises this option", "If the reasons ... are as described in paragraph 1 (a)/(b)", "If no agreement is reached", "If it withdraws the specification")
warrant_basis: Warranted by the explicit conditional procedural dependencies among the steps of Article 8; the electrical-safety branch (A8.P2) is an external procedure and is not coded as S content

pattern_rule: Forum-constitution pattern: designation of a single Committee assisting the Commission, chaired by a Commission representative, serviced by a Commission secretariat, with its own rules of procedure, membership assistance, and consideration of questions at the request of its Chairman or a Member State
